summary: Interim excipient compatibility matrix for the Esmervane EP-11 capsule work (DL_2026_0085). Results so far cover the vehicle screen and the first blend compatibility rows. The lactose-containing blend showed a colour change, the stress analyses are still running, and the alternative filler remains under evaluation, so the conclusions are not final.
